g.text: Two independent duplications: the Saccharomycotina ancestor (D=43) and the mushroom ancestor (D=23)
PIF1/RRM3 duplications and losses on the fungal species tree
719-taxon grafted phylogenomic tree (GeneRax UndatedDL). Coral node area = per-node duplications; the two large nodes are the
interpreted events, the many faint ones are fine-scale reconciliation noise (global D=476). Open tips within a clade = single-copy reversion (loss).
